# Full-game native integration independent review

Verdict: suitable to advance to actual e8 CUDA infrastructure qualification after the minor provenance/bit-check fixes below. This is not production selection, CUDA qualification, or strength evidence. Main primary cache/journal experiment is unchanged.

The earlier blocking defects are corrected: immutable base WDL is carried independently, T=1 and fresh opening roots are required, zero-action freshly reset games are retained without a false truncation counter, and native state has independent epoch/actor/optimizer attempted/accepted/rejected counters. Terminal mover WDL alternates correctly; natural draws receive draw WDL, and caps/tails remain unknown and excluded. Clipped action ratios and game-uniform/position-uniform sampling remain explicit surrogate objectives with completion-selection/inverse-length weighting limitations.

The model used for collection is a separate eval/no-gradient behavior snapshot copied once per epoch. Base is immutable and hashed. Whole-buffer KL is game-balanced and evaluated after each pass; a rejected pass restores model, Adam, Python/NumPy/TorchCPU/allCUDA and sampler RNG, then stops. Rejected update costs remain in attempted/rejected counters. Interrupted phases leave closed=False and cannot publish native state.

Closed native snapshots contain current/base/behavior, Adam, global/actor/seed-sampler RNG, last sampler RNG, full actor cursor, independent counters, source/input/runtime pins, chain, and last frozen epoch archive. Buffers are explicitly closed-empty; subsequent epoch sampling draws a fresh seed from preserved seed RNG. Loader checks model portable/native digests, full last-epoch legality/targets, actor and behavior match, archived chain, and restores all RNG after observational model loading. No midpass resume is claimed. Runner requires clean pinned checkout/import origins, immutable source/config/inputs/resources and original absolute deadline across pause/resume. Guards run at inference/minibatch/KL chunks and before/after publication; a supervising owned-process whole deadline remains necessary to interrupt long initialization/serialization operations.

Minor fixes communicated directly:

- `sampler_rng_state_before_epoch` currently returns the variable captured before each pass; with multiple passes it records the last attempted pass's starting state. Capture an independent epoch-start state once. This does not change current replay dynamics but is incorrect provenance.
- Frozen inherited material validation uses numerical torch.equal. Replace with byte-view equality for promised all21 storage-bit invariant, including signed zero. Base digest is already exact bytes.

Independent bounded CPU evidence: first invocation from /workspace produced 13 PASS, one explicit actualCUDA SKIP, and one sourceguard test failure because its required Git-checkout working directory was absent. Reran only that test from the pinned checkout: 1 PASS. Combined: all14 tests pass under required cwd; one actualCUDA case remains unexecuted. CPU exact freshprocess whole2 versus pause1/resume2 journals and six native files pass. No GPU or additional experiment was run by reviewer.

The prepared CUDA qualifier correctly runs clean CLI whole2 and pause1/fresh-resume2 with one shared <=180s deadline, requires positive accepted terminal updates, compares journals and six native payload bytes, and strictly loads both final native containers in a further process. Input SHA and CUDA schema are checked; root must inject actual e8 weights/frozen config and keep parent whole deadline and failure receipts. It is infrastructure evidence only; retain explicit duplicate presentation/update costs. Promotion to production still requires actual CUDA success, frozen protocol/config/resources/final-selection and qualification ledger assignment before execution.
